book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN MATEO

content: Yal Comam Jesús yin̈ mac ecꞌbal yelapno yehi
Yin̈ huneꞌ tiempohal tuꞌ, iskꞌambe ebnaj iscuywom Comam Jesús tet hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —¿Mac ecꞌbal yelapno xol anma ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Dios? ẍi ebnaj.
Yawtenti Comam huneꞌ nichꞌan unin yanico Comam xolbal ebnaj.
Yalni Comam: —Yin̈ caw yeli chiwalan teyet, ta mach chehel hebeybal, yeb ta mach cheyiyo heba hacaꞌ nichꞌan unin tiꞌ, mach chu heyoc yul iskꞌab Comam Dios.
Yuxin mac chiyiyo isba hacaꞌ nichꞌan unin tiꞌ, haꞌ ecꞌbal yelapno xol mac ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Dios.
Yuxin haꞌ mac chichahni hunu nichꞌan unin yuto wetan yehi, haninan chinischahan, ẍi Comam Jesús.
Caw ay ismay ta chijakꞌ aycꞌayo hunu mac yin̈ istxꞌojal
Yalnipaxo Comam Jesús: —Haꞌ mac chiakꞌni lectaho hunu mac uninto yanico isba yul inkꞌaban, cꞌul iscꞌallaxico hunu niman ischꞌenal chꞌen molino
yet trigo yin̈ isnukꞌ, cat iskꞌojlaxayto xol haꞌ mar, sata ta chioc yakꞌaꞌ aycꞌayo hunu maca.

Caw biscꞌulal yet anma ay yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ yuto hantan̈e tzet bay wal yaycꞌayi. Wal tuꞌ caw yeli, yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ ayn̈eticꞌa yin̈ bay chaycꞌay anma, yajaꞌ xin cꞌanchꞌan mac chiakꞌni aycꞌayo hunu maca.

Yuxin tato hekꞌab maca heyoj chexakꞌni aycꞌayo yin̈ istxꞌojal, cꞌulmi hetzocꞌniltoj cat hekꞌojnito nahat. Waxan̈ca matxa tzꞌajano henimanil yet chechahni hekꞌinal mach istan̈bal ecꞌbalto cꞌul sata ta tzꞌajan henimanil yet chexalaxto xol kꞌa kꞌaꞌ mach istan̈bal.

Ta isbakꞌ hesat chexakꞌni aycꞌayo xin, cꞌulmi heyiniltij cat hekꞌojnito nahat, wal xin waxan̈ca hunxan̈e isbakꞌ hesat ayicto yet chechahni hekꞌinal mach istan̈bal sakꞌalmi heyet sata ta chexalaxto xol kꞌa kꞌaꞌ yeb iscabil isbakꞌ hesat, ẍi Comam.
Yechel yin̈ noꞌ meꞌ cꞌaynatoj
Yalnipaxo Comam Jesús: —Nann̈e heyu, tajca chehincꞌuln̈e hunu mac uninto yanico isba yul inkꞌaban, chiwalan teyet, ebnaj ángel chitan̈en ebnaj tiꞌ ayco ebnaj yin̈ sat Inmaman yul satcan̈,
yuto Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios, hulnajinan insayaꞌan mac cꞌaynatoj.
Kꞌinalo ta ay hunu naj ay cien ismeꞌ cat xin iscꞌayto hunu noꞌ, ¿mataxca xin mach chacano naj noꞌ noventa y nueve, cat isto naj issayno noꞌ cꞌaynato tuꞌ?
Yajaꞌ ta chiilcha noꞌ yu naj xin, yin̈ caw yeli chiwalan teyet tato ecꞌbalto chitzala naj yin̈ noꞌ cꞌaynaticꞌato tuꞌ sata yin̈ noꞌ noventa y nueve mach cꞌaynahotoj.
Hac tuꞌ Comam ay yul satcan̈, mach chisje iscꞌul tato ay hunu mac uninto yul inkꞌaban chicꞌaytoj, ẍi Comam. Yin̈ tzet chu jakꞌni nimancꞌulal jin̈ hununon̈ (Lc 17:3) Yalnipaxo Comam Jesús:
—Ta ay hunu hawuẍta chiwatxꞌen hunu istxꞌojal tawin̈, as tzotelan̈ tet naj hachuquil, cat xin hacachni naj. Ta chabeto naj tzet chawala, yocxa akꞌancꞌulal texol chal tuꞌ.
Yajaꞌ ta mach chabeto naj tzet chawala, awteti hunuj maca cawan̈o mac chito tawintaj, haxinwal chiwatxꞌicanayo tzet cheyal tuꞌ yin̈ sat cawan̈ maca oxwan̈ testigo.

Yajaꞌ ta mach chabeto naj yin̈ hacaꞌ tuꞌ, hal tet ebnaj juẍtaj. Taca mach chabeto naj tzet chal ebnaj juẍta tuꞌ xin, hacaꞌ hunu mac mach ohtan̈eho Comam Dios, hac tuꞌ chucano naj yul hesat, maca hacaꞌ hunu ebnaj chiinilo chꞌen tohlabal.
Yin̈ caw yeli chiwalan teyet, sunil tzet checꞌalba yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ chicꞌalbalaxpaxo yul satcan̈, yebpaxo tzet chepuhilo yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, chipuhlaxpaxo yul satcan̈.
Chiwalpaxojan teyet: Tato ay cawan̈ojex hun chu hekꞌanni hunu tzet ye tuꞌ yin̈ hetxah tet Comam Dios yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ chiakꞌlax teyet yu Inmaman ay yul satcan̈.
Yuxin haꞌ bay chiscutxba isba cawan̈ maca oxwan̈ mac yu yinayo isba wetan, ayinicojan xolbal, ẍi Comam.
Lahwi tuꞌ, ishitzico naj Pedro iscꞌatan̈ Comam, iskꞌamben naj: —Mamin, ta ay hunu wuẍtajan chiyaco ismul wetan, ¿hayelmi chiwakꞌ nimancꞌulalan yin̈, tom hujel mato hantaj? ẍi naj.
Istakꞌwi Comam: —Mach chiwalan tawet tato hujeln̈e, walxinto hujel el chielto setenta chawakꞌ nimancꞌulal yin̈ hawuẍtaj, ẍi Comam.
Yechel yin̈ huneꞌ naj machi akꞌni nimancꞌulal
Yalnipaxo Comam Jesús: —Chiwalpaxojan teyet yin̈ anma ayxaco yul iskꞌab Comam Dios, lahan hacaꞌ huneꞌ naj rey ilni hanta iscꞌas ebnaj ismunlawom.
Hayet lan̈an yichico naj yilni hanta iscꞌas ebnaj tuꞌ, yilaxti huneꞌ naj caw ismilalxa iscꞌas tet naj.
Yajaꞌ huneꞌ naj tuꞌ, mach chikꞌoji naj istohlan sunil iscꞌas tuꞌ. Yuxin ischej naj rey tuꞌ txon̈laxoto naj yeb yixal, yeb yuninal, yeb sunil tzet aya.

Wal naj ay iscꞌas tuꞌ xin ay jahno naj sata naj rey, yoc naj yalno tet naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Mamin, caw niman chawute hacꞌul win̈an hayeboxa tzꞌayic, chinkꞌuyayojan chꞌen cat wakꞌnihan sunil incꞌastuꞌan tawet,” ẍi naj.
Wal naj rey tuꞌ, caw tzꞌaycan̈ iscꞌul naj yin̈ naj, yakꞌni tan̈o naj iscꞌas naj tuꞌ sunil, isbejtzolax naj.

Haxa yet yelti naj sata naj rey tuꞌ, yilnayo naj huneꞌ naj yet munlawomal, ay xin hanicꞌ iscꞌas naj tet naj. Yoc yachno naj yin̈ isnukꞌ naj, etzaxan̈e xin majayto ishakꞌo naj yu naj, yalni naj tet naj: “Tinan̈ xin chawacanayo hacꞌas wetan,” ẍi naj.
Wal naj ay iscꞌas tuꞌ ay jahno naj yin̈ sat naj, yalni naj tet naj: “Mamin, niman chawute hacꞌul, hawechman hayeboxa tzꞌayic, chinkꞌuyayojan chꞌen cat wakꞌni incꞌastuꞌan tawet,” ẍi naj.
Yajaꞌ naj bay ay iscꞌas naj tuꞌ, mach yabeto naj tzet yal naj, walxinto yito naj naj tet naj alcal, yalaxicto naj yul preso masanto yakꞌcano naj sunil iscꞌas tuꞌ.
Cꞌuxan xin ay huntekꞌan ebnaj yet munlawomal naj ilni huneꞌ tuꞌ, caw xin tac iscꞌul ebnaj, yuxin to ebnaj yalaꞌ tet naj rey yin̈ tzet yu tuꞌ.
Hayet yaben naj rey huneꞌ tuꞌ, yanito naj yawtemal naj. Yalni naj tet naj: “Hach tiꞌ caw mach hawalil, wakꞌ nimancꞌulalan yin̈ hacꞌas yuto hakꞌan nimancꞌulal wetan.
Estam xin matzꞌay hacꞌul yin̈ hawet munlawomal tuꞌ hacaꞌ mayu istzꞌay incꞌulan tawin̈,” ẍi naj.
Caw xin tit ishowal naj rey tuꞌ yin̈ naj, ischejni naj yalaxocto naj txꞌoj tuꞌ yul preso masanto istohlacano naj sunil iscꞌas tuꞌ, ẍi Comam.
Yalnipaxo Comam hacaꞌ tiꞌ: —Hac tuꞌ chute Inmaman ay yul satcan̈ teyin̈ tato mach cheyakꞌ nimancꞌulal yin̈ sunil heyanma yin̈ heyuẍta chaco ismul teyet, ẍi Comam.

footnotes.text: Ischꞌenal chꞌen molino yet trigo yet payat tuꞌ, cheh noꞌ chiinicꞌo chꞌen yuto caw al chꞌen
